title: Matrix Network
description: Matrix Network is a minecraft server featuring Anarchy, Survival, and Practice modes, offering everything from pure chaos to competitive gameplay.
body:
# **Matrix Network**

Matrix Network isn’t just a server — it’s a battlefield.
Built for players who don’t just play Minecraft… they dominate it.

## Three Modes - Zero Limits.

### Anarchy

No rules. No mercy.
Grief it. Raid it. Betray everyone.
Trust no one — not even your own team.

If you survive here, you’re built different.

### Survival

Grind, build, expand.
Create your empire from nothing and turn it into something untouchable.
Trade, team up, or backstab — your choice.

### Practice

No excuses. Just skill.
1v1, test your aim, perfect your combos.
This is where players become killers.
